rule_metadata.author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
rule_metadata.title: Curl File Upload To File Sharing Websites

rules.rule_text:
title: Curl File Upload To File Sharing Websites
id: e328cc73-f92a-42fb-b3fa-7c2cffda981a
related:
- id: 00bca14a-df4e-4649-9054-3f2aa676bc04
  type: derived
- id: 7d1aaf3d-4304-425c-b7c3-162055e0b3ab
  type: similar
status: experimental
description: Detects usage of curl to upload files to known file sharing domains,
  which may indicate data exfiltration.
author: Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
references:
- https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/advanced-backdoor-squidoor/
date: 2026-03-29
tags:
- attack.exfiltration
- attack.t1567.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
  - Image|endswith: \curl.exe
  - OriginalFileName: curl.exe
  selection_cli_domain:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - 0x0.st
    - bashupload.com
    - chunk.io
    - file.io
    - filebin.net
    - pastebin
    - send.firefox.com
    - temp.sh
    - transfer.sh
    - ufile.io
    - uploadfiles.io
    - wetransfer.com
    - x0.at
  selection_cli_flags:
  - CommandLine|contains:
    - ' --form'
    - ' --upload-file'
    - ' --data'
    - ' -X POST'
    - ' --request POST '
  - CommandLine|re:
    - \s-[FTd]\s
    - \s-sT\s
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate file uploads to these services by administrators or developers
level: high
